product_metadata.title: 2 Pack - SimpleHouseware Stackable Front Loading Beverage Can Dispenser Rack, Chrome
features: Beverage Can Dispenser Rack holds 12 standard size 12 oz soda cans and small size food cans.
Stackable & Slim Design that saves your space. Easy Assembly. No tools required.
Organize your cans and place them in your refrigerator, kitchen and cabinets.
Sturdy metal construction with Elegant Chrome Finish; Dimension: 17.5"L x 5.8"W x 8.5"H (each).
